info.title: Port_Access_Client
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

access_vlan.description:
Reference Resource: [VLAN](#/VLAN)
The access VLAN assigned to this client.

accounting_session_id.description: Accounting session identifier associated with this client's session.

accounting_session_start_time.description: Time (in seconds) since system boot at which the client accounting session was started.

applied_role.description:
Reference Resource: [Port_Access_Role](#/Port_Access_Role)
Access Role applied for the client.

applied_role_type.description: Type of role applied for the client:  `preauth`:         applied for clients that are yet to be                     authenticated.  `auth`:            applied for clients that have been                     authenticated but have not received any                     specific role or attribute from the                     authentication server.  `reject`:          applied for clients that failed                     authentication.  `critical`:        applied for clients that failed                     authentication due to unreachable.                     authentication servers.  `fallback`:        applied for clients that failed                     to onboard, and no role is derived.  `radius-assigned`: applied for clients that have been                     authenticated and received specific role or                     attribute from the authentication server.  `cached-critical`: applied for clients that failed                     authentication due to unreachable                     authentication servers. This role is                     the previously assigned role for the client                     as provided by the server post authentication.  `critical-voice`:  applied to 'voice' clients that failed                      re-authentication due to server                      unreachability   `ubt-fallback`:    applied for clients on an UBT role that failed                      due to UBT zone unreachability.

auth_attributes.description:
Reference Resource: [Port_Access_Client_Auth_Attribute](#/Port_Access_Client_Auth_Attribute)
Authentication method specific port access client attributes.

auth_history.description: The authentication history associated with the client.

auth_failure_reason.description: One instance of recorded information about the authentication failure reason, if any, associated with this client.  `server-timeout`:             authentication server was not reachable.  `supplicant-timeout`:         supplicant was not reachable.  `server-reject`:              authentication server rejected the client.  `no-server`:                  no authentication servers configured  `attribute-processing-error`: error processing attributes received from                                authentication server.

auth_method.description: One instance of recorded information about the authentication method used by this client.  `dot1x`:     Client authentication was triggerd via 802.1X.  `mac-auth`:  Client authentication was triggerd via MAC-authentication.

auth_state.description: One instance of recorded information about the authentication state associated with this client.  `authenticated`:   Client authenticated successfully..  `unauthenticated`: Client authentication failed.  `attempted`:       Client authentication was attempted but never completed.

auth_time.description: Time (in seconds) since system boot when this authentication state was updated.

authenticating_radius_server.description:
Reference Resource: [Radius_Server](#/Radius_Server)
Radius server that authenticated the client.

authorization_failure_reason.description: Reason for authorization failure:  `failed-to-apply-pa-policy`:         Failed to apply Port Access Policy. failed-to-apply-gbp`: Failed to apply Group Based Policy.  `failed-to-assign-mac-based-vlan`:   Failed to assign MAC based VLAN.  `failed-to-assign-vlan`:             Failed to assign VLAN.  `failed-to-assign-vlan-group`:       Failed to assign VLAN group.  `failed-to-assign-ubt-vlan`:         Failed to assign UBT VLAN.  `failed-to-assign-ubt-vlan-to-non-ubt-client`: Failed to assign VLAN - Attempt to assign UBT-VLAN to a non-UBT-client.  `failed-to-setup-user-based-tunnel`: Failed to setup User Based Tunnel.  `failed-due-to-vlan-limit-violation`: Failed to assign VLANs - VLAN limit per role exceeded.  `failed-due-to-pvlan-violation` :    Failed due to Private-VLAN violation.  `failed-to-assign-voice-vlan`:       Failed to assign voice VLAN.  `current-auth-mode-not-allowed-on-lag-interface`: Current Auth-Mode is not allowed on a LAG interface.  `failed-to-apply-macsec-policy`:         Failed to apply MACsec Policy.  `pa-policy-not-allowed-on-mclag-interface`: Port Access Policy is not allowed on a MCLAG interface.  `current-auth-mode-not-allowed-on-mclag-interface`: Current Auth-Mode is not allowed on a MCLAG interface.

client_state.description: Port client access state:  `initialized`:                new client request recieved.  `no-authentication-required`: client authentication is not required.  `authenticating`:             client authentication is in progress.  `interim-authenticated`:      client authenticated via a lower priority method.  `interim-authentication-failed`: client authentication failed by one of the method.  `authenticated`:              client authentication completed successfully.  `authentication-failed`:      client authentication failed.  `authorized`:                 client with a valid and allowed MAC.  `sticky-authorized`:          sticky client with a valid and allowed MAC.  `proxy-authorized`:           client authorized via RADIUS proxy.

previously_applied_role_type.description: Type of role previously applied for the client:  `preauth`:         previously applied role is preauth   `auth`:            previously applied role is auth   `reject`:          previously applied role is reject   `critical`:        previously applied role is critical   `fallback`:        previously applied role is fallback   `radius-assigned`: previously applied role is radius-assigned   `cached-critical`: previously applied role is cached-critical   `critical-voice`:  previously applied role is critical-voice   `ubt-fallback`:    previously applied role is ubt-fallback.

radius_coa_attributes.description: The RADIUS attributes received for the client via a Change Of Authorization (CoA) request.  Outer key: the `attribute_id` is derived from a combination of            RADIUS attribute type, vendor ID and the monotonic            clock time when the CoA request was processed            separated by a `:`.            For standard attribute types, the vendor ID is 0.             Example: For standard attribute `Egress-VLAN-Name`            with type 58, attribute_id will be 58:0:167602531114996.            For vendor specific attributes from Aruba (Vendor-ID            14823) such as `aruba-user-role` and            `aruba-cppm-user-role` the attribute_id will be            26:14823:167602531114996.  Inner key: the `vendor_type_instance` is derived from a            combination of the vendor type associated with a            RADIUS attribute and the nth instance of the            attribute appearing in the same RADIUS message            separated by a `:`.            The value associated with this key is the value            received for that instance of the vendor type.            For standard attributes, the vendor_type is 0.             Example: For standard attribute `Egress-VLAN-Name`,            the first instance of this attribute in a RADIUS            message will have vendor_type_instance as 0:1, the            second instance (if exists) as 0:2 and so on.            For vendor specific attribute `aruba-user-role` with            vendor type 1, the first instance of this attribute in            a RADIUS message will have vendor_type_instance as            1:1, the second instance as 1:2 and so on.            For vendor specific attribute `aruba-cppm-user-role`            with vendor type 23, the first instance of this            attribute in a RADIUS message will have            vendor_type_instance as 23:1, the second instance as            23:2 and so on.

reauthentication_performed.description: Number of times re-authentication is performed for this client.

reauthentication_requested.description: Number of times re-authentication is requested for this client.

role_state.description: Per client role state status.  `not-ready`:                role is not ready for client.  `download-failed`           role download failed.  `not-valid`:                role is not valid for client.  `applied`:                  role has been applied successfully for client.  `application-in-progress`:  role update is in progress for client.  `application-failed`:       role failed to apply for client.

session_creation_time.description: Time (in seconds) since system boot at which the client session was created.

ubt_client_state.description: `bootstrapping`:                client bootstrapping with the UBT cluster.  `bootstrap_timedout`:           client bootstrap timed out.  `bootstrap_failed`:             client bootstrap failed.  `registered`:                   client registered with the UBT cluster.  `unbootstrapping`:              client de-registering from the UBT cluster.  `unbootstrap_timedout`:         client de-registration process timed out.  `deregistered`:                 client de-registered from the UBT cluster.  `resource_unavailable`:         client bootstrapped failed - resource unavailable.

ubt_tunnel_hw_programmed.description: `true`:  Hardware has been programmed to tunnel client traffic           to the UBT cluster.  `false`: Hardware programming error, client traffic is not being           tunneled.

Reference Resource: [UBT_UAC_Tunnel](#/UBT_UAC_Tunnel)
